INSERT INTO CURATED_VISTAR.DATALAKE.zz_T2_SUPPLIER_SALES_AND_MARKET_SHARE_TEMP
SELECT
    DD.FIRST_OF_WEEK,
    DD2.DATE_ID AS WEEK_ID,
    DD.YEAR_NUM,
    DD.WEEK_NUM,
    DW.WH_OPCO_NUM AS OPCO_NUM,
    DI.INV_CLASS,  -- DI.SUBCLASS_CODE,
    SUM(F.INV_COST) AS TOTAL_INV_COST,
    SUM(F.INV_CASES) AS TOTAL_INV_CASES
FROM CURATED_VISTAR.DATAMART.FACT_INVOICE_SALES F
INNER JOIN CURATED_VISTAR.DATAMART.DIM_WAREHOUSE DW
    ON DW.WAREHOUSE_ID = F.WAREHOUSE_ID
INNER JOIN CURATED_VISTAR.DATAMART.DIM_ITEM DI
    ON DI.ITEM_ID = F.ITEM_ID
INNER JOIN CURATED_VISTAR.DATAMART.DIM_CUSTOMER DC
    ON DC.CUSTOMER_ID = F.CUSTOMER_ID
INNER JOIN CURATED_VISTAR.DATAMART.DIM_DATE DD
    ON DD.DATE = F.SLS_INV_DATE
INNER JOIN CURATED_VISTAR.DATAMART.DIM_DATE DD2
    ON DD2.DATE = DD.FIRST_OF_WEEK
INNER JOIN CURATED_VISTAR.DATAMART.UM_T2_CATEGORY CAT
    ON CAT.CATEGORY_NUM = DI.INV_CLASS
LEFT JOIN CURATED_VISTAR.DATAMART.UM_T2_CAT_SUPP_EXCLUSION CS
    ON CS.CATEGORY_NUM = DI.INV_CLASS
   AND CS.SUPPLIER_ID = DI.SUPPLIER_ID
LEFT JOIN CURATED_VISTAR.DATAMART.UM_T2_ITEM_EXCLUSION IE
    ON IE.ITEM_NUMBER = DI.ITEM_NUMBER
WHERE DC.CUSTOMER_CLASS_GROUP_PCDBI = 'CUSTOMER'
  AND DC.MARKET_SEGMENT_CD <> 'FDSV'
  AND DW.WH_ID NOT IN ('CN')
  AND DD.IS_CUR_YEAR_NUM IN (0, -1, -2)
  AND DD.IS_CUR_WK_NUM < 0
  AND CS.SUPPLIER_ID IS NULL
  AND IE.ITEM_NUMBER IS NULL
GROUP BY
    DD.FIRST_OF_WEEK,
    DD2.DATE_ID,
    DD.YEAR_NUM,
    DD.WEEK_NUM,
    DW.WH_OPCO_NUM,
    DI.INV_CLASS  -- , DI.SUBCLASS_CODE
ORDER BY
    DD.YEAR_NUM DESC,
    DD.WEEK_NUM DESC,
    DI.INV_CLASS
